Windows 10/11 x64 与 Ubuntu X11 x64。项目源码采: Windows 10/11 x64 and Ubuntu X11 x64. The application source is MIT licensed; models and third-party components retain their own licenses.
中英互译与日常取词，不需要联网。: Everyday text extraction and Chinese–English translation, without a network.
云端 OCR 会上传所选截图；云端翻译会上传识别文字。自定义接口的数据去向取决于: Cloud OCR uploads the selected image; cloud translation uploads recognized text. A custom endpoint may be local or remote, depending on its address.
先看用途，再看处理方式和使用条件。选中后点击应用。: Compare the purpose, processing method and requirements. Select an option, then apply it.
切换不会下载模型或验证云端凭据。: Switching does not download models or validate cloud credentials.
密钥使用 Windows DPAPI 或 Linux Secret Servic: Credentials use Windows DPAPI or Linux Secret Service. When the Linux secret service is unavailable, they remain in memory until the application exits.
截图、识别原文、译文和密钥不会写入应用日志；不保存截图或翻译历史。结果窗口及重试: Application logs do not contain images, recognized text, translations or credentials. No capture or translation history is saved. Result windows and retry data stay in running memory only.
模型下载、凭据验证和更新检查会访问相应服务。自动更新检查默认关闭，可在外观与启动: Model downloads, credential validation and update checks contact their respective services. Automatic update checks are off by default and can be managed in Appearance & startup.
语言选择后立即保存并生效，不会丢失其他未保存的输入。: Language changes are saved and applied immediately. Other unsaved fields are preserved.
选择方案后，按需配置模型或凭据。语言选择立即保存并切换，其他设置使用保存并应用。: Choose a scheme, then configure any required models or credentials. Language changes apply immediately; use Save and apply for other settings.
需要：随安装包提供的离线基础模型。: Requires: the baseline offline models included with the installer.
